title: Nonnegative graded unital algebras
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring and $A$ an associative unital $R$-algebra. A nonnegative grading on $A$ consists of $R$-submodules $A_i\subseteq A$ for $i\in\mathbf N$ with direct sum as in [def-weil-pbc-direct-sum-modules], such that the additive sum map $\bigoplus_{i\in\mathbf N} A_i\to A$ is an isomorphism, $1\in A_0$, and $A_i A_j\subseteq A_{i+j}$ for all $i,j\in\mathbf N$. Thus the image of $R$ lies in $A_0$. An element of $A_i$ is homogeneous of degree $i$. We write $A=\bigoplus_{i\geq0}A_i$ and extend the notation by $A_i=0$ for negative integers $i$. No commutativity condition on $A$ is imposed.
